risk_if_not_implemented: Without Binary or Machine-Executable Code, applications may be built and deployed with exploitable design and coding weaknesses that adversaries can leverage. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Counterfeit / Non-Conforming Products (MT-20).

compensating_control_1.name: File Activity Monitoring (FAM)
compensating_control_1.description: Automated mechanisms exist to monitor sensitive and/or regulated data in Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) and data repositories.
compensating_control_1.justification: File Activity Monitoring (FAM) (MON-28) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Binary or Machine-Executable Code (END-03.4) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Endpoint File Integrity Monitoring (FIM)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize File Integrity Monitor (FIM), or similar technologies, to detect and report on unauthorized changes to selected files and configuration settings.
compensating_control_2.justification: Endpoint File Integrity Monitoring (FIM) (END-11) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Binary or Machine-Executable Code (END-03.4) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
